name: git
summary: git — the gucOS git CLI over libgit2 1.9.0: init, add, commit, branch, checkout and config (the #475 write set) plus log, show, diff, status, rev-list, rev-parse, cat-file and ls-tree, with the repository discovered from the current directory as in git. merge/tag/reset and the network verbs are not implemented yet (#478 covers the network leg).
